reviews.text: It didnt work for my dog. I did the 4 week board and train for 4k. Then bought an additional week after that to try and help more (that part surprised me since I thought the 4 weeks was gauranteed). I think we needed more individualized help. My vet recommended a special behavioral program im going to try as soon as I can afford it. I dont have any specific complaints about Jeremiah or the buisness, I just wish I would've saved the money to do something 1:1. I read the whole going home packet, and Jerimiah and I did 2 or 3 sessions together after the boarding. She was good at home and short walks, but home wasnt really the problem. She is still good at home but the walks went away. She wasnt interested in the food and the vet told me to stop using the collars because she developed a skin infection. The area was red during her boarding but not infected.  I let it rest after but the repeated rubbing just wasnt working out. I didnt hear back with my last text to Jerimiah and figured there wasnt anything else they could do and I was moving soon anyways. It wasnt for us.. but I see a lot of success stories so maybe it just wasnt a good fit for us and works really well for others. Just so much money saved up for this, I was really hoping to be able to take her put in public and have a normal life together.

It was such a blessing to find Jeremiah to correct the behavior of our German Shepherd.
He has truly changed the quality of our everyday life with our dog. We went from having to constantly stress about him encountering other dogs and humans, not knowing how he will react and how aggressive he might get,
to just sitting at a café with him and watch people walk by, in total relaxation mode.
Jeremiah emphasizes on positive reinforcement and a generous reward system, besides many praises.
Jeremiah took time to also train us on how to carry-on his training and understand how important consistency is.
We are beyond grateful and our dog loves him.
We highly recommend THE TRAVELING HOUNDS not just for training but for boarding as well.
THANK YOU JEREMIAH!!!
Jeremiah did a fabulous job training my Baxter! He was also patient and thorough when teaching us how to continue it at home. I would highly recommended his services!
Outstanding Dog Training Services. After 4 weeks of training my dog is completely transformed !!!! Highly Higly Recommend.

We're sorry to see you rated us 1 star, and we're disappointed we didn't meet your expectations. We’d like to make it right; please contact our customer service team at your earliest convenience or message us here with details so we can resolve the issue. We value your feedback and will use it to improve our service. Thank you for bringing this to our attention.

So my pooch did a month board and train, I saw improvements after the 1st week! Jeremiah was so patient with us during training, and you can see how much he loves dogs. 100% recommend the Traveling Hounds!

Jeremiah truly went above and beyond for my problem child! Zoey was in sore need of some training and the perfect candidate for the Traveling Hounds board & train program. And although she proved to be an especially stubborn pupil, Jeremiah refused to give up on her and helped her get to where she needed to be. I am truly impressed with not only the quality of training he provides for these dogs, but with his level of dedication to making sure that every single one of them goes home set up for success! Thank you so much!!

Jeremiah and his entire team are amazing! We just took our new pup Willow home after the 4 week board and train and we couldn’t be happier with all the progress and training she had with The Traveling Hounds. Thank you so much!

We rescued a dog from a shelter who is totally closed off from any interaction whatsoever. Jeremiah not only brought our little man out of his shell, but helped him find the confidence To become an awful fleece, well-behaved sidekick. I couldn’t recommend him anymore and I continually send people his way whenever they’re having issues with their dogs behavior.

My experience with this dog boarding and training program has been nothing short of amazing. Pluto had become very disobedient after our big move across states and his recent neutering, and I was honestly overwhelmed. They were able to take him in the same day as our consultation, which already showed me how accommodating and professional they are. Over the next three weeks, they completely transformed him. Pluto went from being too excited to even go out in public and distracted by everything around him, to being calm, obedient, and fully attentive to my commands. He’s now a completely improved dog more confident outside, easier to manage at home, and overall such a positive presence in the household. I truly couldn’t be more grateful for the work they put into him. Pricing is reasonable. Updates/follow ups were/are very supportive. I have recommended their program to family, and I will be taking Pluto back when I need assistance.

Jeremiah and the other trainers did great with our dog Rocco . In the 4 weeks Rocco boarded there, they were able to take him out and do things we never imagined he’d be able to do cause he was aggressive . We have seen a huge change in him and can finally take him out and go on normal walks without him barking and trying to go after any and everything . I would highly recommend sending your dogs to them because you can clearly tell they give your dogs just as much love as you do .

The Team was Amazing.  They took care of my Lokie (Belgian Malinois) like he was their own dog.  They cared for him just like I would.  Best of all, Lokie is a different dog and the Training/boarding was worth evey penny and more!
I would recommend The Traveling Hounds to ANYONE that needs their dog trained properly and professionally!  Don't waste your money at Petsmart!

Jeremiah and the staff at Traveling Hounds are amazing! My puppy attended a two-week day school training. She learned all the basic commands like sit, stay, down, place, and heel. More importantly, she learned how to be a brave and confident dog! Before going to Traveling Hounds, our dog was shy and very wary of strangers. Now, she takes any chance to meet someone new as well as new dogs. The staff at Traveling Hounds will treat your dog as if they are their own. Every morning, Jeremiah greeted my dog, Millie, with smiles and pets, no matter how excited or grouchy she was that day.  By the end of the two weeks, they were besties! I would definitely recommend Traveling Hounds for any of your dog training needs. Jeremiah is a true, funny, and experienced professional and we can’t wait to go back for group classes!

Jeremiah and his team took our staffy mix Bluey and was able to train her to our needs. We took Bluey in with three older senior dogs that we already had, Bluey was a year old. This was a big change for our family. Jeremiah listened to our needs for what we wanted our family to look like with four dogs, three older and a baby one. Jeremiah was able to teach Bluey how to calm herself to a level that our other three could communicate with in our home. Jeremiah had Bluey for his four week board and train and we couldn’t be happier with the results. We will be sending one of our other older rescues to him for confidence building also.

Got my dog boarded and trained here and it completely changed her life for the better. Before she was a very anxious and reactive dog and after training , she had been transformed into a confident dog who can pay attention with any distractions around. The amount of love and knowledge that Jeremiah has for each and every dog is unmatched. Jeremiah has truly changed not only our dogs, but our lives for the better. The staff including Rodrigo and Brandon are also fantastic. I highly recommend The Traveling Hounds to anyone looking for a better life with their dog.

I had looked for dog training for a while finally found Jeremiah he is the owner of traveling hounds. We had a problem dog and he was able to get her under control through his board and train program. He socialized her and stopped her barking all the time. Our girl is so much calmer and pleasant to be around now. I recommend them for any of your dog's needs.
Thanks Jeremiah,
Jeff

Jeremiah with Traveling Hounds is fantastic.  He helped us train our very energetic puppy with the basics but also was super responsive to some of our specific concerns on how to address specific issues in our home. We look forward to using the company for more specialized training soon. Our baby puppy is well on the way in his training
Looks good and safe to leave your dog

I could call Jeremiah a "Life Savor"! a "dog whisper" or an "amazing person" or all of the above. He came to help me with my 2 huge 6 months old Labrador/Retriever puppies that we were fostering and I simply could not handle them anymore, sweet, adorable but definitely unruly! I called him and explained my situation to him and he offered to come and pick them up for evaluation and to know how are they going to interact with other dogs. I ended up going to see his place and it was very nice and the most important thing was, that OUR DOGS LOVED HIM! and start to play with him,like he is a member of our family and they know him forever! Amazing! I would like to reassure and highly recommend Jeremiah and his team to everyone who reads this review that he is a trustworthy trainer and you can feel comfortable to let him train your dogs for a better life for everyone, for you as the owner and your dog as a better version of themselves. Happy training :)

Jeremiah is an angel on earth. He’s a kind, animal loving, man who connects with animals in a way like no other. He has fun training and you can tell the animals have fun right along with him. We left our dog with Jeremiah and his trainers shortly Sftw we adopted her from the Humane society. Our wild and crazy Luna came home a calmer, well behaved member of the family. Her spirit is still wild and crazy, but now we know how to rein her in a little. A word of advice: use what you’ve learned to help your dog retain their skills. We haven’t done a great job, but Jeremiah is helping us get her back on the right track
Did an absolutely fantastic job training our dog. When we brought her back to be boarded while we went on vacation, she was absolutely thrilled to be back in their care.

Jeremiah and his team are such caring trainers! From the start, he showed genuine care—not just for our dog, Teddy, but for helping us become better owners.

Our Rottie struggled with leash pulling and reactivity, especially around other dogs. Thanks to Jeremiah’s clear guidance and calm, patient approach, we saw huge improvements. Teddy doesn’t pull during walks now and calmly ignores other dogs.

He didn’t just train Teddy—he taught us how to communicate with him better. We always felt supported, encouraged, and never judged. Thank you so much!

My pup did a two week training here about a month or two ago. He’s a very sweet boy (black lab/chihuahua mix) but he had big issues following directions, whining/barking and was very hyper. When I dropped him off, I explained the things I really needed to get a handle on and I’m happy to say, when he got home, his behavior was so much better and my pup actually listens to me. I was worried that once my pup got home, he would regress back to the way he was but I received training on how to continue on with what he learned during his two week stay and if I have any issues, I just send a text and he’ll let me know what I can do to correct the behavior. I’m very happy with how much better my pup behaves so I highly recommend!

Would 10/10 recommend Jeremiah! When I first adopted my puppy Oscar, he was a terror.  Now after 3 weeks of day school he is now potty trained, crate trained, and his barking is under control! He also knows basic commands.

Oscar gets so excited when we get to school, and is overall so much better at home. I will definitely be signing him up for more classes to learn tricks now!
Jeremiah was amazing! Very patient and helpful when I was getting anxious about my dog’s reaction. Definitely coming back!
The best dog trainer, I know

Jeremiah and the company were incredible. When I dropped off Bruno he was crazy if he saw another dog and today when I picked him up he held place while another dog was roaming and Bruno was off leash. He’s demeanor is extremely calmer and it’s amazing. Can’t wait to work with Jeremiah again and keep Bruno going.

Jeremiah has been amazing working with our puppy on obedience and socialization for the past two weeks in his day program.  He tailors the training to what is important to you and provides daily guidance on how to incorporate the skills he teaches into our routine at home and we are seeing fantastic progress!!  Working so well for us we have signed both of our pups up for another session to work on the interaction between them!  Thanks Jeremiah and Rodrigo!!

Very pleased with the care and high level of daily attention and interaction that was given to both my dogs.  The dogs came home with improved and much more tempered behavior after a 10 day boarding. Lots of daily videos and updates sent whenever I inquired. Also pricing is fair and reasonable.
I recommend both the boarding and/or board & train services

Can’t say enough about how great they were with Benson. It is only his first day home after a 3 week training stay, and he is already getting used to the new environment and having rules to follow. Hopefully I remember to post a follow up in a few weeks.
Jeremiah and team did a great job taking our rescue Abbott Bojangles and turning him from a child scarer to a model citizen with excellent manners. Thanks so much!

I brought home my daughter’s dog after she passed away which had behavioral issues with other animals. I have 3 other dogs at home who he didn’t get along with but after the help from Jeremiah, i havnt had any issues with him getting aggressive with the other dogs at home.

5-Star Review for Jeremiah – Truly Exceptional Dog Trainer

Jeremiah is nothing short of amazing. From the very first session, it was clear that he has a deep understanding of dog behavior and a genuine passion for what he does. His calm, confident approach immediately put both my dog and me at ease, and he tailored the training to suit our specific needs and goals.

What really sets Jeremiah apart is his ability to communicate clearly—not just with dogs, but with their humans too. He explains the why behind every method, making it easy to continue the training at home. His sessions are structured, yet flexible, and always focused on positive reinforcement and building trust.

Thanks to Jeremiah, my dog has gone from anxious and reactive to confident, responsive, and a joy to be around. I’ve seen incredible progress and couldn’t be more grateful. Whether you’re working with a new puppy or an older dog with behavioral challenges, Jeremiah is the trainer you want by your side.

Highly, highly recommend!

I can't say enough good things about Jeremiah as a dog trainer!  I Actually met him while out walking my 3 year old Australian Shepherd. I was just observing him with his Dog doing the most incredible Stay I've ever seen, practically an entire Football field length. We got to talking and I learned he was a professional trainer and i got really good vibes from him. He gave me his card and i decided to have him work with my Genesis.
He formed an incredible bond with my dog right from the start, and it made all the difference in her training. We focused mainly on reactive behavior and working in public spaces, and the results were amazing. Jeremiah’s patience, skill, and genuine connection with my dog truly set him apart. I highly recommend him to anyone looking for a knowledgeable and compassionate trainer. I only wish he still lived here in Arizona — he's truly one of a kind!

I have a 2 year old cane corso who basically did what he wanted
After a month with Jeremiah, he listens and behaves in public settings. He is now a distinguished gentleman. A bit of a gentle giant.

Prompt - Professional - Reliable !!!
describe Jeremiah Magruder, certified dog trainer of Traveling Hounds.
He is most adept in his ability to communicate with canines of every sort, and in training Service Dogs.
We truly miss him since he moved from the Kansas City Missouri area.

What a great experience for our dog! Onyx is high anxiety, high energy, and the Travelling Hounds really helped her establish some new behaviors but more importantly, trained us in how to redirect and reinforce the good behaviors and ignore the bad ones. Jeremiah and his crew really love our four footed friends and you will be amazed at what they can do!

Absolutely amazing experience trained my puppy and turned her around into a well behaved dog that listens!!! Very grateful I would recommend this trading facility a million gagillion percent your dog will love it and you will love it as well!

Jeremiah knows just exactly how to train dogs. He trained my border collie who is very narcotic and got him to be the greatest dog a owner could ask for. Boy only does he know obedience training. He also knows how to do protection training. I was a former bite decoy under his supervision and I have watched him work miracles in dogs behavior
Great obedience dog training, fun environment, had my pitbull want to stay with trainer more because he enjoy time following his instructions and enjoy belly rubs
Thank you! Scout was unique!

Jeremiah is absolutely amazing with dogs! It doesn't matter what size, breed, age or issue... his connection, kindness and compassion is unmatched. And the results are impeccable!! I (both personally and professionally) trust and recommend Jeremiah 100%, no questions asked, you will not be disappointed!!

Fantastic training! Walked us through multiple training methods that immediately made a difference. Very simple to do at home and is easy to get in touch with for extra questions and feedback afterwards. Will be working with him again!

My Shih Tzu puppy was one year old and displaying some negative behaviors, like barking at every sound, reluctance to potty outside, and a defiant attitude toward intervention. Don’t get me wrong, he’s a sweet and lovable little sweet heart, but with the potential to decimate your kingdom. Jeremiah rode in on his white horse and saved us all! Our little guy spent 4 weeks with Jeremiah and changed our lives. Thank you, Jeremiah! You are our Hero!
Jeremiah was amazing with Daisy we saw improvements and are following his tips to keep up the behavior.

Our 6 year old mini schnauzer/terrier mix has always had a fear of people. He would bark, growl and lunge whenever he saw someone. After a few weeks with Jeremiah, Ollie is a lot calmer and less fearful. We are able to go on walks and not have to avoid others walking by. Ollie is also a lot more obedient at home which was another concern of ours since my wife and I are expecting our first child.

Jeremiah has given us a peace of mind and we are very grateful for his expertise, communication and patience. We highly recommend Jeremiah
Excellent trainer! saw a huge difference in our puppy's behavior in only 2 weeks! Jeremiah  makes sure your dog's training meets your expectations, we Highly recommend him!
Jeremiah forms a special bond with your dog. He gives you lots of practical tools to train your dog.  His exercises are tailored to exactly what you need.  We had great success with Jeremiah!

We are so thankful for Jeremiah. Our dog Teddy was a street rescue who was  sweet…and then became out of control (dog/people aggression, destructive behaviors, random reactivity)…all while being such a good dog (loved to play, barked appropriately, foot warmer).

Reached out to a trainer who recommended Jeremiah. We did initial 2 weeks board and train. During that time, Jeremiah sent daily communication, including videos, which really aided for the transition back to home; as well as training sessions while Teddy was still boarding.

Jeremiah’s training was worth every penny, moreover, the change in Teddy was more than I thought possible. *I wanted training to work, was nervous about the results/$.

Now, I am a believer in Jeremiah’s methodology and see the importance of training.

Teddy came back with great behaviors, and a much more stable/happy dog. Then, some remedial training  was needed (mostly due to owners, ie owner needs training)—Jeremiah went above and beyond with home follow-up sessions.

*Picture: Teddy couldn’t wait for “his place” to be set up.

We are beyond thrilled with the transformation in our 2-year-old Boxer, Rocko, thanks to Jeremiah’s training expertise! Before training, Rocko’s behavior was overwhelming—he would pounce on people, bark excessively, and pull on the leash during walks. After working with Jeremiah, not only has Rocko made incredible progress, but we also now understand how to help him overcome these behaviors and reinforce his training.

Rocko is now calmer, more obedient, and a joy to be around. It’s amazing to see him happily spending quality family time with his two human brothers. We are so grateful for Jeremiah’s guidance and highly recommend him to anyone looking to improve their dog’s behavior. Thank you Jeremiah for helping us bring out the best in Rocko!

I have a 2 1/2 year old Rottweiler who listened okay, but only when he wanted too. I brought him to Jeremiah and he was able to make him a completely different dog. He is now trained as a service dog and will accompany me to the store, dinner, or wherever I go. Having the ability to have my dog with me at all times has greatly improved my quality of life as well as my dogs. Best investment I have made for my dog and family.
Our dog  is a pitbull mix and very stubborn and had some issues with other dogs. She now gets along well with others.  We would recommend this facility to others

I was a first time dog owner and learning about how to train my dog on the fly and in the middle of graduate school during a covid lockdown. During all of that combined stress, Jeremiah relieved a lot of it by helping Kai learn lots of commands and puppy discipline at a young age. Now at nearly 4 years old, he still responds so quickly to the same commands Jeremiah helped train him to respond to years later.

This is the best dog Trainer I have experienced.  He took the time to explain the reasons behind what he was teaching me and the dog was very receptive.  If I had questions he always answered promptly. I so would request him again.

**Outstanding Dog Trainer – Highly Recommended!**
